(6) The provisions referred to in paragraph (5) are any provision of, or of any instrument which
is in force under—
(a) the Mineral Workings (Offshore Installations) Act 1971;
(b) the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974 M10 or
(c) the Merchant Shipping Act 1995.
[F107[F108(7) Notwithstanding the provisions of section 4(1)(b) of the Act, a nurse independent
prescriber may, when acting in her capacity as such, supply or offer to supply any controlled drug
specified in Schedule 2 or 5 to any person who may lawfully have any of those drugs in his possession
provided it is supplied or offered in circumstances where she may prescribe it under regulation 6B.]
[
F109(7A) Notwithstanding the provisions of section 4(1)(b) of the Act, a paramedic independent
prescriber or a therapeutic radiographer independent prescriber may, when acting in their capacity
as such, supply or offer to supply any controlled drug specified in Schedule 2 or 5 to any person
who may lawfully have any of those drugs in their possession provided it is supplied or offered in
circumstances where they may prescribe it under regulation 6D.]
